hud_public_housing.terms_note: HUD says to map only addresses geocoded to the rooftop or the ZIP+4 centroid (LVL2KX R or 4); the others sit at the centre of a block group or tract. The observatory follows that: those developments are counted in their municipio but not drawn.

usgs_structures.name: USGS — The National Map, National Structures Dataset
usgs_structures.publisher: US Geological Survey (USGS), National Geospatial Program

more_links.label: Structures map service (the build reads layer 51, Fire Stations/EMS Stations)

usgs_structures.credit: Source: US Geological Survey, The National Map, National Structures Dataset (fire and EMS stations)
usgs_structures.access: ArcGIS REST query of layer 51 (no key), state = 'PR'. The build keeps the identifier, name, feature code, state, load date and point; the address, city and ZIP code are not requested.
usgs_structures.cadence: USGS adds and edits structures continuously (the service said 'Data Refreshed October, 2026'; the newest Puerto Rico station was loaded on 2026-07-17). The observatory re-reads it when the data are rebuilt (python facilities.py --refresh usgs).
usgs_structures.used_for: Fire and EMS stations on the 2D map (fire_stations.geojson) and their count in each municipio (facility_series.json: fire_stations). Also the road distance to the nearest fire or EMS station, by barrio and municipio (essentials_series.json, essentials_barrio.json).
usgs_structures.terms_note: Chosen over OpenStreetMap for fire stations on 2026-10-17: USGS has 94 Puerto Rico stations, OpenStreetMap 77, and 74 of those 77 lie within 500 m of a USGS station. For police stations USGS has only 8, so that layer uses OpenStreetMap.

usac_erate.name: USAC — E-Rate Supplemental Entity Information (open data)
usac_erate.publisher: Universal Service Administrative Company (USAC), for the Federal Communications Commission's E-Rate program
usac_erate.credit: Source: Universal Service Administrative Company, E-Rate Supplemental Entity Information
usac_erate.access: Socrata API (no key), physical_state = 'PR' and entity_type = 'Library', asking only for the entity number and name, type, status, city, county, state, the public, main, bookmobile and kiosk flags and the point. Contacts, telephone, e-mail, web address and street address are never requested.
usac_erate.cadence: USAC updates the dataset daily (2026-10-16 on 2026-10-17). The observatory re-reads it when the data are rebuilt (python facilities.py --refresh usac).
usac_erate.used_for: Public libraries on the 2D map (libraries.geojson) and their count in each municipio (facility_series.json: libraries). Also the road distance to the nearest library, by barrio and municipio (essentials_series.json, essentials_barrio.json).
usac_erate.terms_note: IMLS's Public Libraries Survey has no Puerto Rico rows, so USAC's list is the only machine-readable national source. In Puerto Rico it includes community technology centres and other community libraries registered as public libraries. Some of USAC's points fall in another town: those libraries are counted in the municipio of their address and not drawn. A few names carry a telephone number, which the build removes.

irs_eo_bmf.name: IRS — Exempt Organizations Business Master File Extract (EO BMF), Puerto Rico
irs_eo_bmf.publisher: Internal Revenue Service (IRS), Tax Exempt and Government Entities

more_links.label: The Puerto Rico file (CSV; the build reads it)

irs_eo_bmf.licence: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); neither the IRS page nor Treasury's data catalog states a licence; FPR confirmed this reading on 2026-10-17
irs_eo_bmf.credit: Source: Internal Revenue Service, Exempt Organizations Business Master File Extract, Puerto Rico
irs_eo_bmf.access: The Puerto Rico CSV (no key). The build keeps the city, the first five digits of the ZIP code, the subsection and the NTEE code of each organization; names, EINs, street addresses and financial fields are dropped as the file is read.
irs_eo_bmf.cadence: The IRS renews the file about monthly (the file of 2026-10-13 on 2026-10-17). The observatory re-reads it when the data are rebuilt (python nonprofits.py --refresh).
irs_eo_bmf.used_for: Tax-exempt organizations in each municipio, in all, 501(c)(3) and by NTEE major group (nonprofit_series.json).
irs_eo_bmf.terms_note: The file lists organizations the IRS recognizes as tax-exempt, at their headquarters address. Many Puerto Rico nonprofits are registered only under Puerto Rico law and are not in it.

census_zcta_county.name: US Census Bureau — 2020 ZCTA to county relationship file

more_links.label: The national file (the build reads it)

census_zcta_county.credit: Source: US Census Bureau, 2020 ZCTA to county relationship file
census_zcta_county.access: The national pipe-delimited file (no key); the build keeps, for each Puerto Rico ZIP Code Tabulation Area, the municipio that holds most of its land.
census_zcta_county.used_for: Places a tax-exempt organization in a municipio by its ZIP code when its city is not a municipio's name (nonprofit_series.json).

wcrp_scm.name: Puerto Rico Department of Housing and Foundation for Puerto Rico — WCRP Social Capital Mapping tool, list of Comunidades Especiales
wcrp_scm.publisher: Puerto Rico Department of Housing (PRDOH) and Foundation for Puerto Rico, Whole Community Resilience Planning (WCRP) program
wcrp_scm.licence: No open license stated; an internal program file built jointly by PRDOH and FPR with CDBG-DR funds. FPR publishes it on the observatory with the program's approval (confirmed on 2026-10-19); others should ask PRDOH and FPR before re-using it

short.es: lista del Mapeo de Capital Social de WCRP

wcrp_scm.credit: Source: WCRP Social Capital Mapping tool (Puerto Rico Department of Housing and Foundation for Puerto Rico), list of Comunidades Especiales, date not stated (about 2019-2021)
wcrp_scm.access: The file COMUNIDADES ESPECIALES.csv of the WCRP Social Capital Mapping tool, in FPR's Community Resiliency Planning SharePoint site (folder Datos para mapeo), read on 2026-10-17. It lists 711 Comunidades Especiales by name, municipio and barrio with Yes/No flags for community assets. wcrp_social.py --import keeps only those three names, the polygon of comunidades.geojson each row matches and the nine asset flags, in wcrp_ce_assets.csv; the list's two hazard columns are left out. The list holds no personal data. The copy read through the connector lost the list's accented letters; wcrp_social.py restores them from the matching polygon's name where it can.
wcrp_scm.cadence: A one-time list: its date is not stated (the WCRP Social Capital Mapping list, about 2019-2021, from the Junta de Planificación inventory). No live source exists, so nothing refreshes it.
wcrp_scm.used_for: The community-asset flags of the Comunidades Especiales on the WCRP page (wcrp_social.json, assets): counts by municipio and each community's flags in its pop-up.
wcrp_scm.terms_note: Foundation for Puerto Rico runs WCRP in collaboration with the Puerto Rico Department of Housing (PRDOH), with HUD CDBG-DR funds (U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development). The SCM manual calls the tool a joint effort of PRDOH and FPR. The list states no license or terms, so no open license is stated. FPR approved publication on 2026-10-19 and confirmed the same day that its approval covers republishing this list on the observatory. That approval is not an open license: anyone else who wants to re-use the list should ask PRDOH and FPR first. The WCRP page carries an 'In review' marker and may change.

epa_tri.name: EPA — Toxics Release Inventory (TRI), Basic Data Files
epa_tri.publisher: US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), TRI Program

more_links.label: Envirofacts download of the Puerto Rico file (the build reads it)

epa_tri.licence: EPA Standard Open Data License: unless otherwise specified, data EPA produces are in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); EPA disclaims any warranty
epa_tri.credit: Source: US EPA, Toxics Release Inventory, Basic Data File for Puerto Rico (reporting year 2024), downloaded October 2026
epa_tri.access: Envirofacts' download service (no key): the Basic Data File of Puerto Rico for the newest reporting year EPA has published (the build tries this year and the three before). One row per chemical; the build keeps one row per facility with its TRI id, name, industry sector, reporting year and point. Street addresses, parent companies and the rest are dropped as the file is read.
epa_tri.cadence: EPA publishes a reporting year's data the following summer and revises it later. The observatory re-reads it when the conditions unit is rebuilt (python conditions.py --refresh tri).
epa_tri.used_for: TRI facilities in each barrio and municipio (conditions_series.json and conditions_barrio.json: epa_tri). Pounds of toxic chemicals released, in total and to the air, in each municipio (infrastructure_series.json: tri_release_lb, tri_air_lb). No name or point is published.
epa_tri.terms_note: EPA's data catalog (edg.epa.gov/data.json) lists its datasets under the EPA Standard Open Data License, which says EPA data are public domain unless otherwise specified; nothing on the TRI pages says otherwise.

epa_frs.name: EPA — Facility Registry Service (FRS), Facility Interests map service
epa_frs.publisher: US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Office of Mission Support

more_links.label: FRS Facility Interests map service (the build reads layers 8 and 22)

epa_frs.licence: EPA Standard Open Data License: unless otherwise specified, data EPA produces are in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); EPA disclaims any warranty
epa_frs.credit: Source: US EPA, Facility Registry Service (Risk Management Plan facilities and Superfund National Priorities List sites), downloaded October 2026
epa_frs.access: ArcGIS REST queries (no key): layer 8 (all facility interests) for Puerto Rico's Risk Management Plan (RMP) interests, and layer 22 (SEMS_NPL) for Puerto Rico's National Priorities List sites. The build keeps the registry id, name, program, status and point; the address, city, ZIP code and web links are not requested.
epa_frs.cadence: FRS is updated continuously from EPA's program systems. The observatory re-reads it when the conditions unit is rebuilt (python conditions.py --refresh frs).
epa_frs.used_for: RMP facilities FRS marks active and NPL sites currently on the final list, counted in each barrio and municipio (conditions_series.json and conditions_barrio.json: epa_rmp, epa_npl).
epa_frs.terms_note: EPA's data catalog lists every FRS layer under the EPA Standard Open Data License. FRS lists 157 RMP interests in Puerto Rico, 33 of them marked active; only the active ones are counted. Risk Management Plans themselves (and their offsite consequence analyses) are not read.

epa_attains.name: EPA — ATTAINS assessment units (water quality, Clean Water Act 303(d) list)
epa_attains.publisher: US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Office of Water

more_links.label: ATTAINS Assessment feature service (EPA's hosted layer; the build reads layer 2, areas)

epa_attains.licence: EPA Standard Open Data License: unless otherwise specified, data EPA produces are in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); EPA disclaims any warranty; the layer's own licence text says EPA geospatial data are public domain unless otherwise specified
epa_attains.credit: Source: US EPA, ATTAINS, Puerto Rico assessment units (2024 reporting cycle), downloaded October 2026
epa_attains.access: ArcGIS REST query of EPA's hosted ATTAINS Assessment layer 2 (areas), state = 'PR' (no key). The build keeps the unit's id, name, category, impaired and 303(d) flags, reporting cycle and outline. Puerto Rico has no point or line units in the service.
epa_attains.cadence: States report every two years; EPA updates the service when it acts on a report. The observatory re-reads it when the conditions unit is rebuilt (python conditions.py --refresh attains).
epa_attains.used_for: The share of each barrio's and municipio's area inside a unit on the 303(d) list (conditions_series.json and conditions_barrio.json: epa_303d_pct).
epa_attains.terms_note: Puerto Rico maps the assessment units of its rivers and streams as the land that drains to each assessed reach, so the 179 listed units cover about half of the island's land.

epa_greenbook.name: EPA — Green Book, non-attainment areas (lead 2008, sulfur dioxide 2010)
epa_greenbook.publisher: US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Office of Air Quality Planning and Standards

more_links.label: Non-attainment areas map service (the build reads layers 3 and 4)

epa_greenbook.licence: EPA Standard Open Data License: unless otherwise specified, data EPA produces are in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); EPA disclaims any warranty; the map service states 'Access constraints: None. Use constraints: None.'
epa_greenbook.credit: Source: US EPA, Green Book non-attainment areas (lead 2008 and sulfur dioxide 2010 standards), downloaded October 2026
epa_greenbook.access: ArcGIS REST queries (no key) of layers 3 (lead, 2008 standard) and 4 (sulfur dioxide 1-hour, 2010 standard), state_abbreviation = 'PR'. The build keeps each area's id, name, pollutant, current status and outline.
epa_greenbook.cadence: EPA updates the service weekly from its own database; designations change rarely. The observatory re-reads it when the conditions unit is rebuilt (python conditions.py --refresh greenbook).
epa_greenbook.used_for: The share of each barrio's and municipio's area inside a lead or sulfur dioxide non-attainment area (conditions_series.json and conditions_barrio.json: epa_naa_lead_pct, epa_naa_so2_pct).

epa_lmop.name: EPA — Landfill Methane Outreach Program (LMOP), landfills with coordinates
epa_lmop.publisher: US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Landfill Methane Outreach Program

more_links.label: All Landfills in LMOP Database with Coordinates (EPA's hosted layer; the build reads it)

epa_lmop.licence: EPA Standard Open Data License: unless otherwise specified, data EPA produces are in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); EPA disclaims any warranty
epa_lmop.credit: Source: US EPA, Landfill Methane Outreach Program, landfills in the LMOP Database (data of September 2024), downloaded October 2026
epa_lmop.access: ArcGIS REST query of EPA's hosted layer (no key), county_state ending ', PR'. The build keeps each landfill's name, status, LMOP category, opening and closure years and point; the owner organization is not requested.
epa_lmop.cadence: EPA updates the LMOP Database about once a year (the layer was last edited on 2024-09-20). The observatory re-reads it when the conditions unit is rebuilt (python conditions.py --refresh lmop).
epa_lmop.used_for: Municipal solid waste landfills, open or closed and still open, in each barrio and municipio (conditions_series.json and conditions_barrio.json: epa_landfills, epa_landfills_open).
epa_lmop.terms_note: EPA's data catalog lists 'All Landfills in LMOP Database with Coordinates' under the EPA Standard Open Data License. LMOP lists municipal solid waste landfills only: no open dumps, transfer stations, recycling centres, industrial or hazardous waste landfills. No source of open dumps or other solid waste facilities in Puerto Rico states terms (wanted.json: open-dumps).

hud_chas.name: HUD — Comprehensive Housing Affordability Strategy (CHAS) data by census tract
hud_chas.publisher: US Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), Office of Policy Development and Research (eGIS); tabulated by the US Census Bureau

more_links.label: CHAS by tract feature service (the build reads layer 1)
HUD open data catalog (DCAT, states the licence)
CHAS on HUD User (newer releases; refuses scripted downloads)

hud_chas.licence: U.S. Public Domain (the licence HUD's open data catalog gives this dataset: the usa.gov public domain label); HUD adds a disclaimer of warranty and liability
hud_chas.credit: Source: US Department of Housing and Urban Development, Comprehensive Housing Affordability Strategy (CHAS) data, 2016-2020 ACS 5-year, census tracts (HUD eGIS), downloaded October 2026
hud_chas.access: ArcGIS REST query of HUD's eGIS layer (no key), STATE = '72': the tract id and three counts of Table 2 (all households; owners and renters with one or more of the four severe housing problems). The release (Date of Coverage) is read from the item's description.
hud_chas.cadence: HUD releases a new CHAS window about once a year on HUD User; the eGIS layer lags (2016-2020 on 2026-10-17, while HUD User has 2018-2022). The observatory re-reads the layer when the conditions unit is rebuilt (python conditions.py --refresh chas), and the freshness check watches the layer for a new release.
hud_chas.used_for: Households with one or more severe housing problems and their share, by municipio (exact) and by barrio (an estimate spread from tracts by 2020 housing units) (conditions_series.json and conditions_barrio.json: chas_severe_hh, chas_severe_pct).
hud_chas.terms_note: HUD User's CHAS downloads (2018-2022, published December 2025) sit behind a bot check that refuses scripts, as its LIHTC, Fair Market Rent and Income Limits files do; the observatory does not get around it. The eGIS layer is the newest release a script may read. Counts in CHAS are rounded by the Census Bureau, and the layer publishes no margins of error.

census_tiger_lines.name: US Census Bureau — TIGER/Line Shapefiles, all lines (EDGES)

more_links.label: TIGER/Line 2026 EDGES files (the build reads the 78 Puerto Rico files)

census_tiger_lines.credit: Source: US Census Bureau, 2026 TIGER/Line Shapefiles, all lines (EDGES), Puerto Rico
census_tiger_lines.access: The 78 county files of the newest TIGER/Line year (no key; about 55 MB zipped), read with pyshp. The build keeps, for each road edge (ROADFLG = 'Y'), its id, feature class (MTFCC), its two topological nodes and their points.
census_tiger_lines.cadence: The Census Bureau publishes a TIGER/Line year each autumn. The observatory finds the newest year itself when the conditions unit is rebuilt (python conditions.py --refresh tiger).
census_tiger_lines.used_for: Street intersections and their density per square mile, by barrio and municipio (conditions_series.json and conditions_barrio.json: street_intersections, street_intersection_density).

hhs_hospital_capacity.name: HHS — COVID-19 Reported Patient Impact and Hospital Capacity by Facility (geocoded hospital addresses)
hhs_hospital_capacity.publisher: US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), healthdata.gov

more_links.label: Socrata API of the dataset (the build reads ccn and geocoded_hospital_address)

hhs_hospital_capacity.licence: Public Domain U.S. Government (as healthdata.gov states for the dataset)
hhs_hospital_capacity.credit: Source: US Department of Health and Human Services, COVID-19 Reported Patient Impact and Hospital Capacity by Facility (geocoded hospital addresses, last reported April 2024)
hhs_hospital_capacity.access: The dataset's Socrata API (no key): for Puerto Rico, each hospital's certification number and HHS's geocoded point, the last week it reported. Only the point is kept, in the local cache: it places the hospitals OpenStreetMap does not, it is where the build looks for the OpenStreetMap building of a hospital whose name matches only in part, and for the hospitals OpenStreetMap places by name it shows how far HHS's point lies from the building. Nothing from HHS is published.
hhs_hospital_capacity.cadence: HHS stopped updating the dataset on 2024-05-03, so it is never re-checked. Hospitals rarely move; a new hospital it lacks is located by OpenStreetMap or by hand (conditions.HAND_POINTS).
hhs_hospital_capacity.used_for: The point of 15 of the 52 general hospitals the drive time is measured to, and the place where the build finds the OpenStreetMap building of 8 more (conditions_series.json and conditions_barrio.json: hosp_drive_min, hosp_road_km). The points are cached locally and never published.
hhs_hospital_capacity.terms_note: HHS geocoded street addresses; for the 27 hospitals OpenStreetMap places by name, HHS's point lies a median 0.7 km and up to 5.6 km from the building, and in another barrio for 13 of them. That is why OpenStreetMap is tried first, and why which barrios show 0 minutes is uncertain near the 15 hospitals placed at HHS's point.

nps_nrhp.name: National Park Service — National Register of Historic Places, public locations
nps_nrhp.publisher: National Park Service (NPS), Cultural Resources GIS, for the National Register of Historic Places

more_links.label: Map service (the build reads layers 0, points, and 1, polygons)

nps_nrhp.licence: Public domain: a US federal government work. NPS states no named licence; the map service's licence field says 'For general public distribution' and its metadata calls the public data general reference data. Treated as public domain, as other federal data are (decided by FPR on 2026-10-18)
nps_nrhp.credit: Source: National Park Service, National Register of Historic Places, public spatial data
nps_nrhp.access: ArcGIS REST queries (no key) of layer 0 (points) and layer 1 (polygons), State = 'PUERTO RICO'. The build keeps the reference number, name, resource type, city, listing date, status and one point (for a listing with only a polygon, a point inside it); the street address is never requested.
nps_nrhp.cadence: NPS edits the data as properties are listed (Data.gov: updated 2026-09-18; the newest Puerto Rico edit was 2026-08-07 and the newest listing 2026-01). The observatory re-reads it when the data are rebuilt (python community_assets.py --refresh nps).
nps_nrhp.used_for: Historic places on the 2D map (historic_places.geojson) and their count in each municipio (community_series.json: nrhp_places).
nps_nrhp.terms_note: Restricted and sensitive listings, such as archaeological sites, are not in the public data. NPS says the data are for general reference: using them does not satisfy consultation under Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act, and the points and outlines can be imprecise (most points come from the nomination's coordinates). NPS gives no warranty and asks users to get the data from its own servers. Private residences, and listings whose name holds a street address or house number, are counted in their municipio but not drawn, and their names are not published (decided by FPR on 2026-10-18; the reviewed list is nrhp_review.json in the repository). No address is published.

samhsa_nsumhss.name: SAMHSA — National Directories of substance use and mental health treatment facilities (N-SUMHSS)
samhsa_nsumhss.publisher: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA), Center for Behavioral Health Statistics and Quality

more_links.label: 2025 National Directory of Drug and Alcohol Use Treatment Facilities (Excel and PDF)
2025 National Directory of Mental Health Treatment Facilities (Excel and PDF)
FindTreatment.gov (the live locator; not used, see the note)

samhsa_nsumhss.licence: Public domain: the directories carry SAMHSA's Public Domain Notice (they may be reproduced or copied without permission; citation is appreciated; they may not be reproduced or distributed for a fee without SAMHSA's written authorization)
samhsa_nsumhss.credit: Source: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration, 2025 National Directories of Drug and Alcohol Use and of Mental Health Treatment Facilities (2024 National Substance Use and Mental Health Services Survey)
samhsa_nsumhss.access: The Excel file of each directory, found on SAMHSA's National Directories page (no key), read in memory. For each Puerto Rico row the build keeps the city, the state, the type-of-care codes (substance use, mental health, co-occurring) and a one-way hash of the name and address that joins the two directories; names, addresses, telephones and the files themselves are never written to disk.
samhsa_nsumhss.cadence: Yearly: the 2025 directories (survey of 2024) were released on 2026-03-06. The observatory looks for a newer edition on the National Directories page and re-reads it when the data are rebuilt (python community_assets.py --refresh samhsa).
samhsa_nsumhss.used_for: Substance use and mental health treatment facilities in each municipio, in all and by type of care (community_series.json: bh_all, bh_su, bh_mh, bh_both). Counts only.
samhsa_nsumhss.terms_note: These are sensitive services, so the observatory publishes counts only: no facility name, address, telephone or point. The directories list the facilities that answered the survey and agreed to be listed; most individual practitioners are not in them. FindTreatment.gov, SAMHSA's live locator, is more current, but its API guide states no licence and speaks of 'approved users', so it is not used (wanted.json: samhsa-locator).

fpr_gii_2021.name: FPR — Global Innovation Index, Puerto Rico country profile (2021)
fpr_gii_2021.publisher: Centro de Innovación de Foundation for Puerto Rico

short.es: GII de FPR 2021

fpr_gii_2021.credit: Source: Centro de Innovación de Foundation for Puerto Rico, Global Innovation Index: Puerto Rico country profile (2021), calculated with the GII 2020 method of Cornell University, INSEAD and WIPO
fpr_gii_2021.access: FPR's two-page profile (PDF created 2021-09-26) and its working file, both internal. The profile's 80 indicators, values, ranks and marks were copied as printed into docs/analysis/gii-2021/gii_original.json on 2026-10-23; the working file was read only to explain differences. No name, email or telephone number from either file is copied.
fpr_gii_2021.cadence: A frozen snapshot: the 2021 profile does not change. Corrections are notes beside the printed values, never edits.
fpr_gii_2021.used_for: The original values, ranks 'x / 132' and marks of the Global Innovation Index page of the Knowledge Area (gii_profile.json: value, shown, rank, star, hourglass, year).
fpr_gii_2021.terms_note: FPR's own calculation, not an official WIPO ranking: Puerto Rico is not in the official Global Innovation Index. FPR has not stated a license for the profile. Some 2021 values come from proprietary sources (IHS Markit country risk, Clarivate Web of Science, Brand Finance) and are shown as FPR published them, not updated.
fpr_gii_2021.access_es: El perfil de dos páginas de FPR (PDF creado el 2021-09-26) y su archivo de trabajo, ambos internos. Los 80 indicadores, valores, posiciones y marcas del perfil se copiaron tal como se publicaron en docs/analysis/gii-2021/gii_original.json el 2026-10-23; el archivo de trabajo solo se leyó para explicar diferencias. No se copió ningún nombre, correo electrónico ni teléfono de esos archivos.
fpr_gii_2021.cadence_es: Una instantánea fija: el perfil de 2021 no cambia. Las correcciones son notas junto a los valores publicados, nunca cambios.
fpr_gii_2021.used_for_es: Los valores originales, las posiciones 'x / 132' y las marcas de la página del Índice Global de Innovación del Área de conocimiento (gii_profile.json: value, shown, rank, star, hourglass, year).
fpr_gii_2021.terms_note_es: Cálculo propio de FPR, no una clasificación oficial de la OMPI: Puerto Rico no está en el Índice Global de Innovación oficial. FPR no ha declarado una licencia para el perfil. Algunos valores de 2021 vienen de fuentes propietarias (riesgo país de IHS Markit, Web of Science de Clarivate, Brand Finance) y se muestran como FPR los publicó, sin actualizar.

wipo_gii2020.name: Cornell University, INSEAD and WIPO — The Global Innovation Index 2020 (method and definitions)
wipo_gii2020.publisher: Cornell University, INSEAD and the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)
wipo_gii2020.licence: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 IGO (report page ii); third-party data excluded

short.es: GII 2020

wipo_gii2020.credit: Cornell University, INSEAD and WIPO (2020): The Global Innovation Index 2020: Who Will Finance Innovation? Ithaca, Fontainebleau and Geneva
wipo_gii2020.access: The report and its Appendix III, read for the framework (7 pillars, 21 sub-pillars, 80 indicators), the definitions (summarized in FPR's own words) and the marks of each indicator (composite, survey, half weight, higher is worse).
wipo_gii2020.used_for: The structure and the definitions of the Global Innovation Index page (gii_profile.json), and the method behind FPR's printed ranks. No other economy's GII 2020 data are published.
wipo_gii2020.terms_note: Licensed CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 IGO: no derivatives without WIPO's permission. FPR's ranks place Puerto Rico's value among the GII 2020 values, so they derive from that edition; the page shows only Puerto Rico's values and the ranks FPR printed in 2021, and an open licence review records the question for Compliance.
wipo_gii2020.access_es: El informe y su Apéndice III, leídos para el marco (7 pilares, 21 subpilares, 80 indicadores), las definiciones (resumidas en palabras de FPR) y las marcas de cada indicador (compuesto, encuesta, peso a la mitad, más alto es peor).
wipo_gii2020.used_for_es: La estructura y las definiciones de la página del Índice Global de Innovación (gii_profile.json), y el método de las posiciones que publicó FPR. No se publican datos del GII 2020 de ninguna otra economía.
wipo_gii2020.terms_note_es: Licencia CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 IGO: no se permiten obras derivadas sin permiso de la OMPI. Las posiciones de FPR ubican el valor de Puerto Rico entre los valores del GII 2020, por lo que se derivan de esa edición; la página muestra solo los valores de Puerto Rico y las posiciones que FPR publicó en 2021, y una revisión de licencia abierta deja la pregunta a Cumplimiento.

wipo_gii2026.name: WIPO — Global Innovation Index 2026 database

short.es: GII 2026 de la OMPI

wipo_gii2026.credit: Source: WIPO (2026). Global Innovation Index 2026, database. Licensed CC BY 4.0. Adapted by Foundation for Puerto Rico; WIPO is not responsible for the adaptation.
wipo_gii2026.access: The database file (943,159 bytes as WIPO serves it, SHA-256 bbce0a2d...ffd73; a copy in a folder that SharePoint or OneDrive syncs gains customXml metadata parts and so another hash, which gii.py also records; downloaded on 2026-10-23 with FPR's approval) is kept in the local cache (cache/gii/2026/) and read with openpyxl in read-only mode by 'python -I gii.py --extract-2026', which keeps, for each of the 79 indicators, the screened values (no economy names), the year most economies use and FPR's checks of WIPO's method on its own data (direction, plain min-max or log transform, the range no winsorization caps, the rank rule). The extract stays in the cache.
wipo_gii2026.cadence: One edition a year (the 19th, 2026-09-29, 139 economies, 79 indicators). A new edition is read when FPR updates the page.
wipo_gii2026.used_for: The indicative GII 2026 position of Puerto Rico's updated value in 10 indicators whose source and definition match (gii_profile.json: c26_*): the number of economies with data, the year most use, the 25th, 50th and 75th percentiles and Puerto Rico's place among them, written X/N. Also the threshold of the change marker (chg_thr: 5% of the interquartile range of each indicator) and the structure, method and indicator list behind 'Changes in the index since 2020' (gii_changes.json).
wipo_gii2026.terms_note: CC BY 4.0 allows reuse and adaptation with credit to WIPO, the changes marked and a statement that WIPO is not liable. Third-party data in the database are excluded from WIPO's licence, so no economy's values are republished and no economy is named: only counts, the data year, three percentiles and Puerto Rico's indicative place. A percentile can coincide with one economy's value (the median in 8 of the 10 compared indicators), without saying which. Not an official GII rank.
wipo_gii2026.access_es: El archivo de la base de datos (943,159 bytes tal como lo sirve la OMPI, SHA-256 bbce0a2d...ffd73; una copia en una carpeta que sincronizan SharePoint u OneDrive recibe partes de metadatos customXml y por eso otro hash, que gii.py también anota; descargado el 2026-10-23 con la aprobación de FPR) se guarda en el caché local (cache/gii/2026/) y lo lee con openpyxl, en modo de solo lectura, 'python -I gii.py --extract-2026', que conserva, para cada uno de los 79 indicadores, los valores depurados (sin nombres de economías), el año que usa la mayoría de las economías y las comprobaciones de FPR del método de la OMPI en sus propios datos (dirección, min-max simple o transformación logarítmica, el rango que ninguna winsorización recorta, la regla de las posiciones). El extracto se queda en el caché.
wipo_gii2026.cadence_es: Una edición al año (la 19.ª, 2026-09-29, 139 economías, 79 indicadores). Una edición nueva se lee cuando FPR actualiza la página.
wipo_gii2026.used_for_es: La posición indicativa en el GII 2026 del valor actualizado de Puerto Rico en 10 indicadores cuya fuente y definición coinciden (gii_profile.json: c26_*): el número de economías con datos, el año que usa la mayoría, los percentiles 25, 50 y 75 y el lugar de Puerto Rico entre ellas, escrito X/N. También el umbral del marcador de cambio (chg_thr: el 5 % del rango intercuartílico de cada indicador) y la estructura, el método y la lista de indicadores de «Cambios en el índice desde 2020» (gii_changes.json).
wipo_gii2026.terms_note_es: CC BY 4.0 permite reutilizar y adaptar con crédito a la OMPI, marcando los cambios y declarando que la OMPI no es responsable. Los datos de terceros de la base de datos están excluidos de la licencia de la OMPI, así que no se republican los valores de las economías ni se nombra ninguna: solo conteos, el año de los datos, tres percentiles y el lugar indicativo de Puerto Rico. Un percentil puede coincidir con el valor de una economía (la mediana en 8 de los 10 indicadores comparados), sin decir cuál. No es una posición oficial del GII.

wb_wgi.name: World Bank — Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI)

short.es: WGI del Banco Mundial

wb_wgi.credit: Source: World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators (2026 update), CC BY 4.0
wb_wgi.access: World Bank API, no key: api.worldbank.org/v2/country/PRI/indicator/{series}?source=3 for GOV_WGI_GE.EST (government effectiveness), GOV_WGI_RQ.EST (regulatory quality) and GOV_WGI_RL.EST (rule of law); read by gii.py and cached in cache/gii/.
wb_wgi.cadence: Updated once a year (last updated 2026-09-25, data to 2025). Each release revises every past year.
wb_wgi.used_for: The updated values of indicators 1.1.2, 1.2.1 and 1.2.2 of the Global Innovation Index page (gii_profile.json: upd_value, upd_year), and Puerto Rico's 2024 values for their GII 2026 position.
wb_wgi.terms_note: Perception-based composite estimates with standard errors; the World Bank advises against reading small differences between years or economies as meaningful. Because each release revises the past, values from different releases are not comparable.
wb_wgi.access_es: API del Banco Mundial, sin clave: api.worldbank.org/v2/country/PRI/indicator/{series}?source=3 para GOV_WGI_GE.EST (efectividad del gobierno), GOV_WGI_RQ.EST (calidad regulatoria) y GOV_WGI_RL.EST (estado de derecho); las lee gii.py y las guarda en cache/gii/.
wb_wgi.cadence_es: Se actualiza una vez al año (última actualización 2026-09-25, datos hasta 2025). Cada edición revisa todos los años anteriores.
wb_wgi.used_for_es: Los valores actualizados de los indicadores 1.1.2, 1.2.1 y 1.2.2 de la página del Índice Global de Innovación (gii_profile.json: upd_value, upd_year), y los valores de Puerto Rico de 2024 para su posición en el GII 2026.
wb_wgi.terms_note_es: Estimados compuestos basados en percepciones, con errores estándar; el Banco Mundial advierte que no se lean como significativas las diferencias pequeñas entre años o economías. Como cada edición revisa el pasado, los valores de ediciones distintas no son comparables.

wb_wdi.name: World Bank — World Development Indicators (WDI)

short.es: WDI del Banco Mundial

wb_wdi.credit: Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators, CC BY 4.0
wb_wdi.access: World Bank API, no key: api.worldbank.org/v2/country/PRI/indicator/{series} (the United States, USA, for the tariff), read by gii.py and cached in cache/gii/.
wb_wdi.cadence: Updated several times a year (last updated 2026-10-08 for the series used).
wb_wdi.used_for: The updated values of indicators 3.2.3 (NE.GDI.TOTL.ZS), 6.2.2 (IC.BUS.NDNS.ZS) and 4.3.1 (TM.TAX.MRCH.WM.AR.ZS of the United States, FPR's method), the ICT components shown beside 3.1.1 and 3.1.2, and the mirror of UNESCO series used when it is newer (gii_profile.json).
wb_wdi.terms_note: Many WDI series for Puerto Rico are blank (logistics, domestic credit, market capitalization, patents, FDI, high-tech exports). The tariff of the United States stands for Puerto Rico because the US tariff schedule applies there; it is labelled as FPR's method.
wb_wdi.access_es: API del Banco Mundial, sin clave: api.worldbank.org/v2/country/PRI/indicator/{series} (los Estados Unidos, USA, para el arancel); las lee gii.py y las guarda en cache/gii/.
wb_wdi.cadence_es: Se actualiza varias veces al año (última actualización 2026-10-08 para las series que se usan).
wb_wdi.used_for_es: Los valores actualizados de los indicadores 3.2.3 (NE.GDI.TOTL.ZS), 6.2.2 (IC.BUS.NDNS.ZS) y 4.3.1 (TM.TAX.MRCH.WM.AR.ZS de los Estados Unidos, método de FPR), los componentes de TIC que se muestran junto a 3.1.1 y 3.1.2, y la copia de series de la UNESCO que se usa cuando es más reciente (gii_profile.json).
wb_wdi.terms_note_es: Muchas series del WDI para Puerto Rico están vacías (logística, crédito interno, capitalización bursátil, patentes, inversión extranjera directa, exportaciones de alta tecnología). El arancel de los Estados Unidos representa a Puerto Rico porque allí aplica el arancel de los Estados Unidos; se identifica como método de FPR.

unesco_uis.name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS) — Data API
unesco_uis.licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 IGO (CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO)

short.es: UIS de la UNESCO

unesco_uis.credit: Source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), UIS Data API, February 2026 release, CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO
unesco_uis.access: UIS Data API, no key: api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/data/indicators?indicator={code}&geoUnit=PRI, read by gii.py and cached in cache/gii/.
unesco_uis.cadence: Data releases about twice a year (February 2026 for the series used).
unesco_uis.used_for: The updated values of indicators 2.1.1 (XGDP.FSGOV), 2.1.3 (SLE.1T8), 2.1.5 (PTRHC.2T3.QUALIFIED), 2.2.1 (GER.5T8), 2.2.2 (FOSGP.5T8.F500600700) and 2.2.3 (MOR.5T8.40510) of the Global Innovation Index page (gii_profile.json).
unesco_uis.terms_note: Share-alike: an adaptation must carry the same licence. The series are revised between releases, so the printed 2021 values may differ from the current ones for the same year. Inbound mobility for Puerto Rico is a UIS estimate.
unesco_uis.access_es: API de datos del UIS, sin clave: api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/data/indicators?indicator={code}&geoUnit=PRI; las lee gii.py y las guarda en cache/gii/.
unesco_uis.cadence_es: Publica datos unas dos veces al año (febrero de 2026 para las series que se usan).
unesco_uis.used_for_es: Los valores actualizados de los indicadores 2.1.1 (XGDP.FSGOV), 2.1.3 (SLE.1T8), 2.1.5 (PTRHC.2T3.QUALIFIED), 2.2.1 (GER.5T8), 2.2.2 (FOSGP.5T8.F500600700) y 2.2.3 (MOR.5T8.40510) de la página del Índice Global de Innovación (gii_profile.json).
unesco_uis.terms_note_es: Compartir igual: una adaptación debe llevar la misma licencia. Las series se revisan entre ediciones, por lo que los valores publicados en 2021 pueden diferir de los actuales para el mismo año. La movilidad entrante de Puerto Rico es un estimado del UIS.

imf_weo.name: IMF — World Economic Outlook (DataMapper)
imf_weo.licence: IMF copyright and usage terms: free reuse with attribution

short.es: WEO del FMI

imf_weo.credit: Source: International Monetary Fund, World Economic Outlook (October 2026), DataMapper
imf_weo.access: IMF DataMapper API, no key: imf.org/external/datamapper/api/v1/PPPGDP and NGDP_RPCH, read by gii.py and cached in cache/gii/ (the server refuses this project's User-Agent, so that request goes with the library's default).
imf_weo.cadence: Twice a year (April and October); the latest years are IMF estimates and the following ones projections, which gii.py leaves out.
imf_weo.used_for: The updated value of indicator 4.3.3 (GDP in PPP dollars) and the real GDP growth of the FPR estimate of 6.2.1 (gii_profile.json).
imf_weo.terms_note: The IMF allows reuse of its data with attribution, under its copyright and usage terms. Values are revised between editions: 2019 GDP in PPP dollars is 119.6 billion in the current edition, against the 126.9 billion FPR took from the October 2019 edition.
imf_weo.access_es: API de DataMapper del FMI, sin clave: imf.org/external/datamapper/api/v1/PPPGDP y NGDP_RPCH; las lee gii.py y las guarda en cache/gii/ (el servidor rechaza el User-Agent de este proyecto, así que esa solicitud va con el de la biblioteca).
imf_weo.cadence_es: Dos veces al año (abril y octubre); los últimos años son estimados del FMI y los siguientes, proyecciones, que gii.py deja fuera.
imf_weo.used_for_es: El valor actualizado del indicador 4.3.3 (PIB en dólares PPA) y el crecimiento del PIB real del estimado de FPR de 6.2.1 (gii_profile.json).
imf_weo.terms_note_es: El FMI permite reutilizar sus datos con atribución, según sus términos de derechos de autor y de uso. Los valores se revisan entre ediciones: el PIB de 2019 en dólares PPA es 119,600 millones en la edición actual, frente a los 126,900 millones que FPR tomó de la edición de octubre de 2019.

fac.name: Federal Audit Clearinghouse — single audits

more_links.label: Single audit rules (2 CFR 200, subpart F)

fac.licence: Public domain: "The data collected by the FAC is free to use and in the public domain" (FAC data page)

short.es: Federal Audit Clearinghouse

fac.credit: Source: Federal Audit Clearinghouse, US General Services Administration, single audits of the municipio governments
fac.access: FAC API (https://api.fac.gov), with a free api.data.gov key in the X-Api-Key header (FAC_API_KEY, HANDOFF decision 70; the only key the build uses, never stored in the repository or published). One request to the general table for every Puerto Rico audit (auditee_state PR, without the contact fields), then one request to the federal_awards table per fiscal year for the municipio governments' audits (first downloaded 2026-10-31).
fac.cadence: An audit is due 30 days after the auditor's report or nine months after the fiscal year ends, whichever is first, and many are late. The FAC holds audits of fiscal years 2016 onward; in the 2026-10 snapshot the observatory holds municipal fiscal years 2016 to 2025. It re-reads the list of audits only when FPR rebuilds the data (economy_series.py --fac --refresh), and downloads award lines only for fiscal years with new audits.
fac.used_for: Federal money spent by each municipio government in its fiscal year, in total, received directly or through a pass-through entity, and by federal agency (economy_series.json).
fac.terms_note: The FAC data page states that the data it collects are free to use and in the public domain (checked 2026-10-31). Audits of fiscal years 2016 to 2022 were migrated from the Census Bureau's clearinghouse to GSA in federal fiscal year 2024. The general table also holds the names, e-mail addresses and phone numbers of auditee and auditor contacts; the build never requests those fields.

lineage.en: Single audits filed by each municipio government: federal money spent in its fiscal year (July to June). The awards behind these dollars also appear in USAspending (as obligations, often to the Commonwealth) and in OpenFEMA; the stages differ, so they are never added together.

hud_lihtc.name: HUD — National Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) Database
hud_lihtc.publisher: US Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), Office of Policy Development and Research (HUD USER)

more_links.label: The database archive (LIHTCPUB.ZIP; saved by hand)
Missing data by year placed in service

hud_lihtc.licence: US Government work (17 U.S.C. 105: no copyright in the United States); HUD USER states no other licence for the database

short.es: Base de datos LIHTC de HUD

hud_lihtc.credit: Source: US Department of Housing and Urban Development, National Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) Database, Puerto Rico
hud_lihtc.access: HUD USER answers scripts with a bot check, so the archive LIHTCPUB.ZIP is saved by hand from a browser to cache/facilities/lihtcpub.zip (HANDOFF decision 71) and the build reads LIHTCPUB.xlsx inside it. It keeps the Puerto Rico rows and these columns: the HUD project id, project name, city, state, latitude, longitude, 2020 tract and county, total and low-income units, year placed in service, construction type, credit type, the no-longer-monitored flag and the homeless and special-population targets. The street address and ZIP code are not kept.
hud_lihtc.cadence: HUD adds the projects placed in service in a year each spring (the release of 2026-05-28 covers 1987 to 2024; 2025 is due in spring 2027). Rebuilt with python facilities.py --only lihtc after a new archive is saved.
hud_lihtc.used_for: Tax credit housing projects on the 2D map and the 3D view (lihtc.geojson) and LIHTC projects, units and low-income units in each municipio (facility_series.json: lihtc_projects, lihtc_units, lihtc_li_units).
hud_lihtc.terms_note: The newer of HUD's two LIHTC sources: the eGIS layer of the same name stops at projects placed in service in 2020 (last edited 2024-12-09). HUD geocoded only some Puerto Rico projects to a point; the others carry a city only. Projects for people who are homeless or living with HIV are counted, never drawn or named.

nmtc.name: CDFI Fund — New Markets Tax Credit (NMTC) public data release
nmtc.publisher: US Department of the Treasury, Community Development Financial Institutions Fund (CDFI Fund)
nmtc.licence: US Government work (17 U.S.C. 105: no copyright in the United States); the CDFI Fund states no other licence for the file

short.es: Datos NMTC del CDFI Fund

nmtc.credit: Source: US Department of the Treasury, CDFI Fund, New Markets Tax Credit public data release
nmtc.access: The build reads the CDFI Fund's data releases page, takes the newest file named NMTC_Public_Data_Release_includes_…xlsx (the 2026-08-06 release: investments of 2001 to 2023) and reads its sheet of financial notes, one row per investment, with the project id, 2020 census tract, year, amount and state. No key.
nmtc.cadence: One release a year, in the summer, adding the investments of about three years earlier. python economy_series.py --nmtc --refresh looks for a newer file.
nmtc.used_for: Investment in low-income communities with New Markets Tax Credits by municipio and year (economy_series.json: nmtc_qlici, nmtc_projects).
nmtc.terms_note: The file also names each project's Community Development Entity and city; the observatory publishes only dollars and counts by municipio and year.

lineage.en: The CDFI Fund's public release of New Markets Tax Credit investments. Private investment made with a federal tax credit, not federal spending; kept out of spending totals.

usgs_water.name: USGS — Water Data API (reservoir water levels, river flow, groundwater levels and rainfall)
usgs_water.publisher: US Geological Survey (USGS), Water Resources Mission Area; Caribbean-Florida Water Science Center

more_links.label: USGS, Hydrologic Conditions of Selected Reservoirs in Puerto Rico
USGS Real-Time Flood Impacts (flood reference points)

usgs_water.credit: Source: US Geological Survey, Water Data for the Nation (provisional data subject to revision)
usgs_water.access: OGC API, no key: monitoring-locations (state_code 72; site_type_code LK for lakes and reservoirs, ST for streams, GW for wells), latest-continuous (parameter 72376 for reservoir levels, 00060 for river discharge, 72019 for the depth to water in a well) and daily (72375; 00060 with statistic 00003, the mean of the day; 72019). Rainfall: latest-continuous by bounding box (parameter 00045, precipitation), daily with statistic 00006 (the sum of the day) and, from the page, continuous (the 15-minute readings of the last 24 hours, as CSV). The build reads the daily values; the page reads the latest values in the visitor's browser (the API allows requests from any site). Without a key USGS limits the requests an hour and answers 429 with the seconds to wait; river_gauges.py waits and asks again. Since 2026-11-12 the river build also reads the gauge height (00065) and, where reported, the water temperature (00010) of each river gauge, and the flood reference points of Puerto Rico from USGS Real-Time Flood Impacts (api.waterdata.usgs.gov/rtfi-api/referencepoints/state/46, no key).
usgs_water.cadence: Readings every 15 minutes or so; daily values the next day. The page reads the latest when a layer is switched on; the observatory rebuilds the daily values and usual levels and flows once a month (python reservoirs.py --refresh; python river_gauges.py --refresh; python groundwater.py --refresh; python rain_gauges.py --refresh).
usgs_water.used_for: Reservoir levels (reservoirs.geojson), River flow (river_gauges.geojson), Groundwater levels (groundwater.geojson) and Rainfall (rain_gauges.geojson) on the 2D map and the 3D view.
usgs_water.terms_note: USGS marks recent data provisional. Checked 2026-11-02: 121 lake or reservoir sites in Puerto Rico, 26 with a reading in the last 30 days. Checked 2026-11-11: 1,083 stream sites in Puerto Rico, 76 with a discharge reading in the last 30 days, 71 of them with at least 8 years of daily values in 2011-2025. Checked 2026-11-12: 5,197 well sites in Puerto Rico, 34 with a depth-to-water reading in the last 30 days; 83 sites with a precipitation reading, 54 of them in the last 30 days.

nasa_black_marble.name: NASA Black Marble — VNP46A3, monthly night-time lights (VIIRS on Suomi NPP, collection 2)
nasa_black_marble.publisher: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (Black Marble team); distributed by NASA's Level-1 and Atmosphere Archive and Distribution System (LAADS DAAC)

more_links.label: Product page at LAADS DAAC (layers, quality flags, file format)
The method: Román et al. (2018), Remote Sensing of Environment 210, 113–143
The archive the build lists (for developers; downloads need a NASA Earthdata login)

nasa_black_marble.licence: NASA data from a NASA-led mission: Creative Commons Zero (CC0) unless a product is marked otherwise; NASA strongly urges users to cite the data
nasa_black_marble.credit: Source: NASA Black Marble, VNP46A3 collection 2 (https://doi.org/10.5067/VIIRS/VNP46A3.002), LAADS DAAC; Román, M.O., et al., 2018, NASA's Black Marble nighttime lights product suite, Remote Sensing of Environment 210, 113–143, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2018.03.017
nasa_black_marble.access: LAADS DAAC lists the files openly; a download needs a free NASA Earthdata login. The build reads one user token from the EARTHDATA_TOKEN environment variable (a GitHub Actions secret) and sends it only to LAADS; the site never calls NASA and visitors need no login (HANDOFF decision 75). One HDF5 file a month for tile h11v07, which holds all of Puerto Rico (about 70 MB); the build keeps a summary for each area and deletes the file. No image is published.
nasa_black_marble.cadence: NASA posts each month about seven weeks after it ends. The observatory reads the new months when FPR runs the build (python nightlights.py, or the Night-time lights workflow).
nasa_black_marble.used_for: The mean night-time radiance and the share of pixels of poor quality or gap-filled, by month (2012-01 to 2026-09) and by year (2012-2025), for the 78 municipios, the 901 barrios and Puerto Rico (nightlights_series.json, nightlights_barrio.json, nightlights_monthly.json). Also the months for night-time light to come back after Hurricanes María and Fiona, and the lowest month after each, by barrio and municipio (storm_recovery_series.json, storm_recovery_barrio.json).
nasa_black_marble.terms_note: NASA's data use guidance says data from NASA-led missions are CC0 unless marked otherwise, places no restriction on their use and strongly urges users to cite them; it also asks that NASA be acknowledged as the source and that use not suggest endorsement. The observatory will cite the product's DOI and Román et al. (2018) wherever the figures appear. The login is NASA's condition for downloading, not a licence term.
nasa_black_marble.access_es: LAADS DAAC publica la lista de archivos sin restricción; para descargarlos se necesita una cuenta gratuita de NASA Earthdata. La compilación lee un token de usuario de la variable de entorno EARTHDATA_TOKEN (un secreto de GitHub Actions) y lo envía solo a LAADS; el sitio nunca consulta a la NASA y los visitantes no necesitan cuenta (decisión 75 de HANDOFF). Un archivo HDF5 al mes del mosaico h11v07, que contiene todo Puerto Rico (unos 70 MB); la compilación guarda un resumen por área y borra el archivo. No se publica ninguna imagen.
nasa_black_marble.cadence_es: La NASA publica cada mes unas siete semanas después de que termina. El observatorio lee los meses nuevos cuando FPR corre la compilación (python nightlights.py o el flujo Night-time lights).
nasa_black_marble.used_for_es: La radiancia nocturna media y la proporción de píxeles de calidad baja o rellenados, por mes (2012-01 a 2026-09) y por año (2012-2025), para los 78 municipios, los 901 barrios y Puerto Rico (nightlights_series.json, nightlights_barrio.json, nightlights_monthly.json). También los meses para que volviera la luz nocturna tras los huracanes María y Fiona, y el mes más oscuro después de cada uno, por barrio y municipio (storm_recovery_series.json, storm_recovery_barrio.json).
nasa_black_marble.terms_note_es: La guía de uso de datos de la NASA dice que los datos de misiones dirigidas por la NASA son CC0 salvo que se indique otra cosa, que no tienen restricciones de uso y que se recomienda encarecidamente citarlos; también pide reconocer a la NASA como fuente y no sugerir su respaldo. El observatorio citará el DOI del producto y a Román et al. (2018) dondequiera que aparezcan las cifras. La cuenta es la condición de la NASA para descargar, no un término de la licencia.

usgs_landsat_c2_st.name: USGS — Landsat 8 and 9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (ST_B10) and pixel quality (QA_PIXEL)
usgs_landsat_c2_st.publisher: US Geological Survey (USGS) Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center, with NASA; copy served by Microsoft Planetary Computer

more_links.label: The copy the build reads: Planetary Computer, Landsat Collection 2 Level-2
USGS: Landsat Collection 2 surface temperature (method and accuracy)
USGS: Landsat Collection 2 quality assessment bands (QA_PIXEL bits)

usgs_landsat_c2_st.licence: US Government work, public domain; USGS asks that Landsat data be credited
usgs_landsat_c2_st.credit: Source: Landsat 8-9 OLI/TIRS Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature, courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey (https://doi.org/10.5066/P9OGBGM6), read from Microsoft Planetary Computer
usgs_landsat_c2_st.access: The build reads Microsoft Planetary Computer's copy with its anonymous access token (no account; the AWS copy is requester-pays), by HTTP range requests at the first overview (60 m), only the tiles over Puerto Rico (raster.py, about 2 MB a scene). The site never calls Planetary Computer. No image is published.
usgs_landsat_c2_st.cadence: A scene every 8 days on each of six path/rows with Landsat 8 and 9 together; the observatory uses the last three complete summers (June to September), so its figures change once a year, after September (refresh unit heat).
usgs_landsat_c2_st.used_for: The median and 90th-percentile land surface temperature on clear summer mornings, the share of land among Puerto Rico's hottest tenth and the residents living there, for the 78 municipios, the 901 barrios and Puerto Rico (heat_series.json, heat_barrio.json).
usgs_landsat_c2_st.terms_note: USGS-authored or produced data and information are in the public domain; USGS asks for credit ('courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey'). Planetary Computer's terms of use cover access to its copy, not the data's licence.
usgs_landsat_c2_st.access_es: La compilación lee la copia de Microsoft Planetary Computer con su token de acceso anónimo (sin cuenta; la copia de AWS cobra al que solicita), por solicitudes HTTP de rango en la primera vista general (60 m), solo los mosaicos sobre Puerto Rico (raster.py, unos 2 MB por escena). El sitio nunca consulta Planetary Computer. No se publica ninguna imagen.
usgs_landsat_c2_st.cadence_es: Una escena cada 8 días en cada una de seis rutas y filas con Landsat 8 y 9 juntos; el observatorio usa los últimos tres veranos completos (junio a septiembre), así que sus cifras cambian una vez al año, después de septiembre (unidad de actualización heat).
usgs_landsat_c2_st.used_for_es: La temperatura mediana y del percentil 90 de la superficie terrestre en mañanas despejadas de verano, la proporción del terreno entre la décima parte más caliente de Puerto Rico y los residentes que viven allí, para los 78 municipios, los 901 barrios y Puerto Rico (heat_series.json, heat_barrio.json).
usgs_landsat_c2_st.terms_note_es: Los datos e información creados o producidos por el USGS son de dominio público; el USGS pide reconocimiento ("cortesía del U.S. Geological Survey"). Los términos de uso de Planetary Computer cubren el acceso a su copia, no la licencia de los datos.

copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance, Collection 1 — red (B04), near-infrared (B08) and scene classification (SCL)
copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.publisher: European Space Agency (ESA) for the European Union's Copernicus programme; copy served by Element 84's Earth Search on AWS (Registry of Open Data)

more_links.label: The copy the build reads: Earth Search, collection sentinel-2-c1-l2a (AWS Registry of Open Data)
ESA: Sentinel-2 processing and the Collection-1 processing baseline
USGS: how to read NDVI values

copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data terms: free, full and open use, with credit
copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2024-2026, processed by ESA; read from Earth Search on AWS (Element 84)
copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.access: The build reads Earth Search's public copy on AWS (no account, no key) by HTTP range requests at 40 m (the second overview of the 10 m bands, the first of the 20 m scene classification), only the tiles over Puerto Rico (raster.py), and keeps each scene's clear cells and their NDVI (about 1 MB a scene at most). The site never calls Earth Search. No image is published.
copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.cadence: A view every 2 to 5 days with Sentinel-2A, 2B and 2C; the observatory uses the last three complete summers (June to September), the window of surface heat, so its figures change once a year, after September (refresh unit vegetation).
copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.used_for: The median vegetation greenness (NDVI) on clear summer days, the share of land with dense vegetation and with little or none, and the residents living on land with little or no vegetation, for the 78 municipios, the 901 barrios and Puerto Rico (vegetation_series.json, vegetation_barrio.json).
copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.terms_note: The Copernicus Sentinel data terms allow free, full and open use, including reproduction, distribution, adaptation and commercial use, with the credit 'Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [year]' for modified data. Earth Search and the AWS Registry of Open Data serve the copy; their terms cover access, not the data's licence.
copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.access_es: La compilación lee la copia pública de Earth Search en AWS (sin cuenta ni clave) por solicitudes HTTP de rango a 40 m (la segunda vista general de las bandas de 10 m y la primera de la clasificación de la escena, de 20 m), solo los mosaicos sobre Puerto Rico (raster.py), y guarda de cada escena las celdas despejadas y su NDVI (a lo sumo 1 MB por escena). El sitio nunca consulta Earth Search. No se publica ninguna imagen.
copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.cadence_es: Una vista cada 2 a 5 días con Sentinel-2A, 2B y 2C; el observatorio usa los últimos tres veranos completos (junio a septiembre), la ventana del calor de superficie, así que sus cifras cambian una vez al año, después de septiembre (unidad de actualización vegetation).
copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.used_for_es: El verdor mediano de la vegetación (NDVI) en días despejados de verano, la proporción del terreno con vegetación densa y con poca o ninguna, y los residentes que viven en terreno con poca o ninguna vegetación, para los 78 municipios, los 901 barrios y Puerto Rico (vegetation_series.json, vegetation_barrio.json).
copernicus_sentinel2_l2a.terms_note_es: Los términos de los datos Sentinel de Copernicus permiten el uso libre, pleno y abierto, incluida la reproducción, distribución, adaptación y uso comercial, con el crédito "Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [año]" para datos modificados. Earth Search y el Registro de Datos Abiertos de AWS sirven la copia; sus términos cubren el acceso, no la licencia de los datos.

nasa_ecostress_lste.name: NASA ECOSTRESS — Tiled Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity, Instantaneous L2, 70 m, version 2 (ECO_L2T_LSTE.002)
nasa_ecostress_lste.publisher: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (ECOSTRESS science team: Hook, S. and Hulley, G.); distributed by the NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC (LP DAAC)

more_links.label: NASA Earthdata: the product's page (layers, quality flags, user guide)
NASA Earthdata: data use and citation guidance

nasa_ecostress_lste.licence: NASA Earth science data: no restrictions on use (CC0); NASA asks that the data be cited
nasa_ecostress_lste.credit: Hook, S., Hulley, G. (2022). ECOSTRESS Tiled Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity Instantaneous L2 Global 70 m V002. NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC. https://doi.org/10.5067/ECOSTRESS/ECO_L2T_LSTE.002
nasa_ecostress_lste.access: The build reads the LP DAAC's cloud copy with FPR's NASA Earthdata token (the one night lights uses, decisions 75 and 80), sent only to NASA's hosts; the LP DAAC answers with a short-lived signed address read by HTTP range requests, only where the barrios' cells fall. The build runs in GitHub Actions with the token as a secret. The site never calls NASA, and no image is published.
nasa_ecostress_lste.cadence: ECOSTRESS flies on the International Space Station and passes several times a week, at a different hour each time; the observatory uses the night passes (21:00 to 06:00) of the last three complete summers (June to September), the window of surface heat, so its figures change once a year, after September (refresh unit night_heat).
nasa_ecostress_lste.used_for: The median and 90th-percentile land surface temperature on clear summer nights, the share of land among Puerto Rico's warmest tenth at night and the residents living there, for the 78 municipios, the 901 barrios and Puerto Rico (night_heat_series.json, night_heat_barrio.json).
nasa_ecostress_lste.terms_note: NASA's data use guidance: data from NASA-led missions carry no restriction on use (CC0), and users are strongly urged to cite them. Downloading needs a free Earthdata login; the published summaries need none.
nasa_ecostress_lste.access_es: La compilación lee la copia en la nube del LP DAAC con el token de NASA Earthdata de FPR (el mismo de las luces nocturnas, decisiones 75 y 80), enviado solo a los servidores de NASA; el LP DAAC responde con una dirección firmada de corta duración que se lee por solicitudes HTTP de rango, solo donde caen las celdas de los barrios. La compilación corre en GitHub Actions con el token como secreto. El sitio nunca consulta a NASA y no se publica ninguna imagen.
nasa_ecostress_lste.cadence_es: ECOSTRESS va en la Estación Espacial Internacional y pasa varias veces por semana, cada vez a una hora distinta; el observatorio usa los pases de noche (de 21:00 a 06:00) de los últimos tres veranos completos (junio a septiembre), la ventana del calor de superficie, así que sus cifras cambian una vez al año, después de septiembre (unidad de actualización night_heat).
nasa_ecostress_lste.used_for_es: La temperatura mediana y del percentil 90 de la superficie terrestre en noches despejadas de verano, la proporción del terreno entre la décima parte más cálida de Puerto Rico de noche y los residentes que viven allí, para los 78 municipios, los 901 barrios y Puerto Rico (night_heat_series.json, night_heat_barrio.json).
nasa_ecostress_lste.terms_note_es: La guía de uso de datos de NASA: los datos de misiones dirigidas por NASA no tienen restricciones de uso (CC0), y se pide encarecidamente citarlos. Descargarlos requiere una cuenta gratuita de Earthdata; los resúmenes publicados no requieren ninguna.

usgs_3dep_13.name: USGS — 3D Elevation Program (3DEP), 1/3 arc-second (about 10 m) seamless digital elevation model
usgs_3dep_13.publisher: US Geological Survey (USGS), National Geospatial Program

more_links.label: The files the build reads: The National Map's staged products on AWS
US Access Board: 2010 ADA Standards, 405.2 (the running slope of a ramp)

usgs_3dep_13.licence: US Government work, public domain; USGS asks for credit
usgs_3dep_13.credit: Source: USGS 3D Elevation Program, 1/3 arc-second seamless DEM, courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey
usgs_3dep_13.access: The build reads the newest version of each one-degree tile over Puerto Rico from The National Map's public files on AWS (no account), by HTTP range requests with raster.py: for climb.py only where the walks to the stops pass (heights every 10 m along the walks), for slope.py the whole of Puerto Rico in windows of 0.1 degree. The site never calls USGS. The published image is slope_surface.png, the mean slope of blocks of about 60 m; no image of heights is published.
usgs_3dep_13.cadence: USGS replaces a tile when better lidar arrives (the Puerto Rico tiles were last replaced on 2026-07-22); the climb figures are rebuilt with the nightly transit refresh, which only writes them when the walkers or the heights change.
usgs_3dep_13.used_for: The round-trip climb of the walk to a stop with a current timetable, and the residents whose walk has a stretch steeper than a ramp may be, for the 78 municipios, the 901 barrios and Puerto Rico (climb_series.json, climb_barrio.json); and the slope of the land: the share steeper than 15% and than 30% and the mean slope, by barrio and municipio (slope_series.json, slope_barrio.json), with the Slope layer's image (slope_surface.png).
usgs_3dep_13.terms_note: USGS-authored or produced data and information are in the public domain; USGS asks for credit ('courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey').
usgs_3dep_13.access_es: La compilación lee la versión más reciente de cada mosaico de un grado sobre Puerto Rico de los archivos públicos de The National Map en AWS (sin cuenta), por solicitudes HTTP de rango con raster.py: para climb.py solo donde pasan los caminos a las paradas (alturas cada 10 m a lo largo de los caminos), para slope.py todo Puerto Rico en ventanas de 0.1 grado. El sitio nunca consulta al USGS. La imagen publicada es slope_surface.png, la pendiente promedio de bloques de unos 60 m; no se publica ninguna imagen de alturas.
usgs_3dep_13.cadence_es: El USGS reemplaza un mosaico cuando llega un lidar mejor (los mosaicos de Puerto Rico se reemplazaron por última vez el 2026-07-22); las cifras de subida se rehacen con la actualización nocturna del transporte, que solo las escribe cuando cambian los caminantes o las alturas.
usgs_3dep_13.used_for_es: La subida de ida y vuelta del camino a una parada con horario vigente, y los residentes cuyo camino tiene un tramo más empinado de lo que puede ser una rampa, para los 78 municipios, los 901 barrios y Puerto Rico (climb_series.json, climb_barrio.json); y la pendiente del terreno: la proporción con más de 15 % y de 30 % y la pendiente promedio, por barrio y municipio (slope_series.json, slope_barrio.json), con la imagen de la capa Pendiente (slope_surface.png).
usgs_3dep_13.terms_note_es: Los datos e información creados o producidos por el USGS son de dominio público; el USGS pide reconocimiento ("cortesía del U.S. Geological Survey").

ogp.name: Oficina de Gerencia y Presupuesto (OGP) — budget data sheets (Sábana) of the Government of Puerto Rico
ogp.publisher: Oficina de Gerencia y Presupuesto, Gobierno de Puerto Rico
ogp.licence: Public documents of the Government of Puerto Rico; OGP states no licence for the data sheets

short.es: Sábanas de presupuesto de la OGP

ogp.credit: Source: Oficina de Gerencia y Presupuesto (OGP), Gobierno de Puerto Rico, budget data sheets (Sábana)
ogp.access: The build reads the links of www.presupuestos.pr.gov and its page for each budget, downloads every data sheet (XLSX) under docs.pr.gov/files/OGP/, and reads one line per agency, fund, program, concept and object of expense, in thousands of dollars. No key.
ogp.cadence: Twice a year: the governor's proposed budget in the spring and the approved budget at the end of June. python ogp_budget.py --refresh reads the site again.
ogp.used_for: The Commonwealth budget by agency, fund, function and concept of expense: spent, approved and proposed (spending_state.json).
ogp.terms_note: The sheets cover the agencies in the fiscal plan, not public corporations with their own budgets. A draft marked Privileged & Confidential that is posted on the site is not read.

lineage.en: OGP's own budget data sheets: the publisher of record for the Commonwealth budget. Federal funds in the budget (Fondos Federales) are also federal awards in USAspending (dedup group ogp_federal); the budget's figures are never added to USAspending's.

jp_pica.name: Junta de Planificación — Programa de Inversiones de Cuatro Años (PICA)
jp_pica.publisher: Junta de Planificación de Puerto Rico
jp_pica.licence: Public document of the Government of Puerto Rico; the Planning Board states no licence

short.es: PICA de la Junta de Planificación

jp_pica.credit: Source: Junta de Planificación de Puerto Rico, Programa de Inversiones de Cuatro Años (PICA)
jp_pica.access: The build finds the adopted program linked from jp.pr.gov, downloads the PDF and reads its agency tables with pdftotext (poppler): one line per project with its municipio, type and four fiscal years, in thousands of dollars. No key.
jp_pica.cadence: Once a year: the Board adopts a new four-year program after public hearings. python pica.py --refresh reads the home page again (needs pdftotext).
jp_pica.used_for: Recommended capital projects by municipio, agency and fiscal year (spending_pica.json).
jp_pica.terms_note: Project names are read but not published; only totals by municipio, agency and year. A draft for public hearing is not used.

lineage.en: The Planning Board's program of recommended capital improvements of agencies and public corporations: a plan, not appropriations or spending. Part of it is funded by federal money (FEMA, HUD, EPA revolving funds) that USAspending and OpenFEMA also report, and by the Commonwealth budget's capital lines (OGP), so its figures are never added to those sources.

eia_intl.name: EIA — International Energy Data (bulk file INTL.zip)

short.es: EIA de EE. UU.

eia_intl.credit: Source: US Energy Information Administration, International Energy Data (bulk file INTL.zip, October 2026), Puerto Rico
eia_intl.access: The bulk file INTL.zip (no key; 24,264,743 bytes on 2026-10-29, one JSON series per line) is downloaded by gii.py, which keeps only three Puerto Rico series in cache/gii/: INTL.2-12-PRI-BKWH.A (net electricity generation, billion kWh), INTL.44-2-PRI-QBTU.A (total energy consumption, quadrillion Btu) and INTL.4419-2-PRI-QBTU.A (consumption from nuclear, renewables and other).
eia_intl.cadence: EIA rebuilds the bulk files twice a day; the Puerto Rico series were last updated in February and March 2026, with data to 2024. gii.py reads the file again with --refresh.
eia_intl.used_for: The FPR estimates of indicator 3.2.1 (electricity output per million people, with the Census Bureau's population; gii_profile.json) and of IN.3.3.2 (low-carbon energy use, new in the GII 2026; gii_changes.json).
eia_intl.terms_note: EIA's copyright page says US government publications are in the public domain and asks for an acknowledgment of EIA as the source. The generation is net (it leaves out what the plants use themselves), while the GII 2026 takes gross production from the International Energy Agency. EIA counts wind, solar and hydro electricity at its energy content (3,412 Btu per kWh). FPR's use of these data is not endorsed by EIA.
eia_intl.access_es: El archivo masivo INTL.zip (sin clave; 24,264,743 bytes el 2026-10-29, una serie JSON por línea) lo descarga gii.py, que guarda solo tres series de Puerto Rico en cache/gii/: INTL.2-12-PRI-BKWH.A (generación neta de electricidad, miles de millones de kWh), INTL.44-2-PRI-QBTU.A (consumo total de energía, cuatrillones de Btu) e INTL.4419-2-PRI-QBTU.A (consumo de fuentes nucleares, renovables y otras).
eia_intl.cadence_es: La EIA reconstruye los archivos masivos dos veces al día; las series de Puerto Rico se actualizaron por última vez en febrero y marzo de 2026, con datos hasta 2024. gii.py vuelve a leer el archivo con --refresh.
eia_intl.used_for_es: Los estimados de FPR del indicador 3.2.1 (producción de electricidad por millón de habitantes, con la población del Negociado del Censo; gii_profile.json) y de IN.3.3.2 (uso de energía baja en carbono, nuevo en el GII 2026; gii_changes.json).
eia_intl.terms_note_es: La página de derechos de autor de la EIA indica que las publicaciones del Gobierno de EE. UU. son de dominio público y pide reconocer a la EIA como fuente. La generación es neta (excluye lo que consumen las propias plantas), mientras que el GII 2026 toma la producción bruta de la Agencia Internacional de Energía. La EIA cuenta la electricidad eólica, solar e hidroeléctrica por su contenido energético (3,412 Btu por kWh). La EIA no respalda el uso que FPR hace de estos datos.

bls_oews.name: BLS — Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), state file

short.es: OEWS del BLS

bls_oews.credit: Source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025 state estimates (oesm25st.zip), Puerto Rico. BLS.gov cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from BLS.gov.
bls_oews.access: The state file oesmYYst.zip (no key; 7,563,829 bytes for May 2025, one .xlsx) is downloaded by gii.py with a descriptive User-Agent (plus the contact in FRESHNESS_CONTACT when it is set, as freshness.py does; bls.gov refuses anonymous requests) and read with the standard library. Only Puerto Rico's total employment (00-0000) and its 22 SOC major groups are kept, in cache/gii/.
bls_oews.cadence: Once a year: the May estimates appear the following spring (May 2025 in May 2026). gii.py takes the newest file with --refresh.
bls_oews.used_for: The FPR estimate of indicator 5.1.1 (knowledge-intensive employment: SOC major groups 11 to 29 as a share of all employment; gii_profile.json).
bls_oews.terms_note: OEWS counts wage and salary jobs in establishments and leaves out the self-employed, so it is not the labour force survey measure the GII 2026 takes from the ILO. Estimates are from three years of survey panels. BLS asks users to cite it as the source.
bls_oews.access_es: El archivo estatal oesmYYst.zip (sin clave; 7,563,829 bytes para mayo de 2025, un .xlsx) lo descarga gii.py con un User-Agent descriptivo (más el contacto de FRESHNESS_CONTACT cuando está definido, como hace freshness.py; bls.gov rechaza las solicitudes anónimas) y lo lee con la biblioteca estándar. Solo se guardan en cache/gii/ el empleo total de Puerto Rico (00-0000) y sus 22 grupos mayores del SOC.
bls_oews.cadence_es: Una vez al año: los estimados de mayo salen la primavera siguiente (mayo de 2025 en mayo de 2026). gii.py toma el archivo más reciente con --refresh.
bls_oews.used_for_es: El estimado de FPR del indicador 5.1.1 (empleo intensivo en conocimiento: los grupos mayores 11 a 29 del SOC como proporción de todo el empleo; gii_profile.json).
bls_oews.terms_note_es: OEWS cuenta empleos asalariados en establecimientos y excluye a los trabajadores por cuenta propia, así que no es la medida de las encuestas de fuerza laboral que el GII 2026 toma de la OIT. Los estimados provienen de tres años de paneles de la encuesta. El BLS pide citarlo como fuente.

fpr_baseline.name: FPR — Eastern Region baseline (field survey and traced routes, 2025)
fpr_baseline.credit: Source: Foundation for Puerto Rico, Eastern Region baseline, 2025 (site visits and municipal routes traced in ArcGIS Pro)
fpr_baseline.access: FPR's internal Eastern Region baseline dashboard holds the survey of illegal dumping sites (21 records with coordinates). The municipal routes FPR traced for the baseline are in an ArcGIS Pro project, exported to fpr_rutas_municipales.geojson. The survey table was read from the dashboard on 2026-10-23 and copied into fpr_vertederos_clandestinos.csv. The source is internal; Finance and Compliance cleared publishing these two layers (2026-11-10).
fpr_baseline.cadence: Copied once, on 2026-10-23. FPR adds or updates rows in fpr_vertederos_clandestinos.csv, or exports the traced routes again, and runs fpr_baseline.py; which traced routes the observatory already has is worked out again at each run.
fpr_baseline.used_for: The Illegal dumping sites and Municipal routes mapped by FPR layers of the 2D map and the 3D view (illegal_dumping.geojson, fpr_routes.geojson).
fpr_baseline.terms_note: The dashboard's other topics are not republished. Its outage figures (SAIDI, SAIFI) come from the Energy Bureau, which receives them from LUMA every month (wanted.json, power-reliability). Of the 59 route stretches FPR traced, the 21 that the observatory's transit layers already cover are left out. The form records no date for each visit.
fpr_baseline.access_es: El tablero interno de la línea base de la Región Este de FPR contiene la encuesta de vertederos clandestinos (21 registros con coordenadas). Las rutas municipales que FPR trazó para la línea base están en un proyecto de ArcGIS Pro, exportadas a fpr_rutas_municipales.geojson. La tabla de la encuesta se leyó del tablero el 2026-10-23 y se copió a fpr_vertederos_clandestinos.csv. La fuente es interna; Finanzas y Cumplimiento autorizaron publicar estas dos capas (2026-11-10).
fpr_baseline.cadence_es: Copiada una vez, el 2026-10-23. FPR añade o actualiza filas en fpr_vertederos_clandestinos.csv, o exporta otra vez las rutas trazadas, y corre fpr_baseline.py; en cada corrida se calcula de nuevo qué rutas trazadas ya tiene el observatorio.
fpr_baseline.used_for_es: Las capas Vertederos clandestinos y Rutas municipales trazadas por FPR del mapa 2D y de la vista 3D (illegal_dumping.geojson, fpr_routes.geojson).
fpr_baseline.terms_note_es: Los demás temas del tablero no se publican de nuevo. Sus cifras de interrupciones (SAIDI, SAIFI) vienen del Negociado de Energía, que las recibe de LUMA cada mes (wanted.json, power-reliability). De los 59 tramos que FPR trazó, se dejan fuera los 21 que las capas de transporte del observatorio ya cubren. El formulario no registra la fecha de cada visita.

dtrh_cpi.name: DTRH — Índice de Precios al Consumidor de Puerto Rico (consumer price index)
dtrh_cpi.publisher: Departamento del Trabajo y Recursos Humanos de Puerto Rico (DTRH), Negociado de Estadísticas del Trabajo

more_links.label: The index on indicadores.pr (CSV from 1984, 2000-01 basket weights)
